title: Effect of Al on the microstructure, mechanical properties, and wear resistance of TiVZrNbAlx alloys
process_description: prepared by arc-melting a mixture of pure metals (purity > 99.95 wt%) in an argon atmosphere and buttons chill cast in place on a water-cooled copper hearth. Each button was remelted at least nine times to ensure the homogeneity of the chemical composition.
